summary: Added missing record_caldav_change calls to create_recurring (created), update_all_day_occurrence (updated), delete_all_day_occurrence (updated), update_occurrence (updated), and delete_occurrence (updated) so no supported mutation bypasses DAV sync.
important_context: Occurrence mutations (update/delete of a single occurrence) record 'updated' not 'deleted' because the series event row persists; only the exception row changes. This matches the existing pattern where the series is the DAV resource.
